newsitem.title: LATVIA: TRANSPORT FLEET SINKS AMID QUIET SHARE TRADE.
newsitem.headline: TRANSPORT FLEET SINKS AMID QUIET SHARE TRADE.

text.p: * Total volume came to 167,000 lats against 161,000 lats.
* Transport Fleet sank some 15 pct to 1.42 lats on 7,800 lats of volume.
* Unibanka was slightly higher at 3.80 lats versus 3.78 lats on trade of 48,300 lats.
* On the secondary list, Daugavpils Chain, Kaija and Brasa were among the most actively traded with other stocks mostly quiet.
Latvian stocks showed more signs of stagnation on Thursday as volume remained stable and no immediate growth was expected, dealers said.
Total volume came to 167,000 lats against 161,000 lats and Rietmu Bank's bourse index fell 2.45 percent to 196.17.
"Stocks are little by little starting to stagnate and there are no expectations of growth in sight," Leonid Ruderman of Parex Bank said. "Prices are stable to lower."
Riga Transport Fleet, an official list stock, sank some 15 percent to 1.42 lats on 7,800 lats of volume.
"It seems, that one buyer of Fleet's shares, which supported its price throughout April has now turned into a seller," Ruderman said.
